frozen_params.response: dlnRV = ln(RV_fwd5) - ln(RV_back5); RV = sum of squared daily log returns
frozen_params.strata: within-market terciles of ln(RV_back5) over the market full eligible series
frozen_params.matching: within-(market,stratum) nearest-neighbour caliper on |r|, caliper 0.25*SD(|r|), greedy one-to-one, stable tie-break (|r| asc, timestamp asc), r_t=0 excluded, reference pool = smaller of NEG/POS (equal -> POS)
frozen_params.statistic: d_(m,s)=mean[pairs](dlnRV_neg - dlnRV_pos); d_m=mean(3 strata); D_class=mean(evaluable markets)

bootstrap.type: synchronized circular calendar blocks over class union calendar
bootstrap.length_rule: nblocks = ceil(T/L) whole blocks, no truncation, no padding

notes.replicate_length_rule: nblocks = ceil(T/L) whole circular blocks; no truncation, no padding
notes.matching_tiebreak: stable sort by |r| on chronologically-ordered records implements (|r| asc, timestamp asc)
notes.caliper_frozen: caliper c = 0.25*SD(|r|) within (m,stratum) computed on original eligible records; frozen into replicates
notes.terciles_frozen: tercile bounds per market computed once on its full eligible series; frozen into replicates
notes.ref_pool_equal: equal NEG/POS size -> reference pool = POS (frozen)
notes.scipy_used: scipy.optimize (Nelder-Mead, fixed start) used only for GJR/EGARCH secondary diagnostics
notes.garch_series: Layer A fit on daily log returns with roll-day returns removed; Layer B on aggregated daily returns
notes.intraday: intraday Layer B RV = sum of squared 1-minute log returns of consecutive same-UTC-day bars; different-frequency object, Layer B only
